description: Sealed booster-box price vs the ESTIMATED value of the cards inside (English Pokemon boxes that pass Flipzi checks). Values are a low/base/high range at CardMarket EUR prices; pull rates are estimates, so this is not a promise about any one box. Omit `set` to list every published box; pass a box `set` slug (from the list) for its top cards and history. Requires the pro plan or higher. Cost: 1 unit.

set.description: Box slug from the list, e.g. "paldea-evolved". Omit to list all published boxes.

name: flipzi_get_box_value
title: Booster box value
